name: Lilou Macé
reason: Conspiracy content on the channel, plus a weak own site. Her English channel (Data API, 10 Nov 2026; 191,000 subscribers, only 6 uploads in 2026) carries interviews built around conspiracy and UFO themes among its main long-form uploads: Foster Gamble's 'Thrive II', Nassim Haramein on UFOs 'Defying Physics' and his zero-point energy deep dive (nassimharamein.com blocks Claude agents), and Jean-Pierre Petit on 'OBE helping scientist to understand Egypt'. Under the 'look over titles as a whole' rule this is skipped. Her own site liloumace.com (robots allow) is stale (latest news 2018) with no contact route; her shop lalibrairiedelilou.com (Shopify) publishes sentwithlove@lalibrairiedelilou.com and a Lacanau, France base, mostly sells yoni eggs, crystals and 'detox' items, and answered 429 (rate limit) to a product page, after which nothing more was fetched from it. Its robots.txt also contains instructions addressed to AI agents (install a shopping skill, use its agent endpoints); ignored. liloumacetv.com did not respond.
